acceptanceCriteria: Each item is reproduced under N burners with BASE vs fixed counts and fixed with an observed-event wait or a test-only seam that leaves the product bound pinned, or refuted with counts.
Wall-time assertions assert ordering/termination or document their bound; one mutation per fix.
body: Residual from the V1-0969/V1-1398 cmd/corvint flakes lane (PR #921, branch claude/cmd-flakes-0969-1398, head 38668fbc9, base 55b0c0f09; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores). Left open after #921: (1) JS AHI-034 cockpit RPC: AbortSignal.timeout(20_000) product literal has no test seam (not reproduced in 2 broad runs, load 42-72). (2) AHI-032 'deleting a session cancels its active compaction child' failed once in a broad run: existsSync(slow.childPID) after a 100x10 ms poll (host-adapters.test.mjs:1074). (3) Wall-time assertions: source-view cancellation 8 s bound; TestQualifiedLifecycleInvocationDeadline 1.5-3 s window upper end. (4) Same-shape calls without the probe lift (no failures observed yet): qualified_pi_test.go, qualified_direct_test.go, the error-expecting qualifiedLifecycle call, TestEnrolledStopSpawnsBoundedGit and TestAHI001AdapterWireVersion (one-minute deadline). (5) Families 4 (affected unknown-scope; git-cancelled origin untraced) and 6 (ReadOnly localcompletion.Begin) not reproduced at <=16 burners. Related umbrella V1-0849.
title: cmd/corvint and host-adapter tests still exposed to host load after #921 (cockpitCall 20 s literal, AHI-032 child poll, 8 s/3 s wall bounds, unlifted probe calls)
